描述_EN: the figure's head is movable, and its hand is detachable. this is the figure of an attendant wearing a red hat with right hand raised, standing on a rectangular plinth, body made of earthenware with cold-painted aubergine pigment. this type of earthenware figurine was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的，其手是可拆卸的。 这是一个戴着红帽子的侍者，举着右手，站在一个长方形的基座上，身体由陶器制成，用冷色调的茄子颜料涂抹。 这种类型的陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
